HanbokVisual.title: See the silhouette before choosing the palette.
HanbokVisual.intro: These rights-reviewed references show real Hanbok styling cues from a museum display, a full-body traditional look and a Seoul boutique palette wall. They are inspiration references, not rental inventory or endorsements.
HanbokVisual.notice: A reference photo can inspire your direction, but the exact colors and garments in your ranked result are still generated by the free deterministic matcher above. Always confirm the actual rental item at the boutique.
